verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API, and a rules-based automation feature is a fair question for it, so the axis applies. The only event-driven capability in the evidence is price-tracking webhooks (channel3-docs-16), which send notifications when a price changes. That is a developer building block for the separate webhooks story, not a way for users to define rules that trigger actions, and no rules engine or condition-to-action configuration is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
